page.overview:
Who is Uchi Akimbo?

Uchi Akimbo (born 1978-1982) was a Slytherin student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1990s.

During the 1996–1997 school year, he surprised Harry Potter in the corridor leading to the Hospital Wing, challenging him to a duel.
